title: Hydrogen Storage in Single-Walled Carbon Nanotubes at Room Temperature
material_description: Sample 3 | SWNTs from the same batch, soaked in 37% HCl for 48 h, rinsed with deionized water, dried at 423 K, then vacuum heat-treated at 773 K for 2 h (sample 3 in text; 'Sample 3#' in Fig. 3); SWNT purity estimated 50 to 60 wt% (TGA and microscopy); semi-continuous hydrogen arc discharge (rotatable graphite-powder anode, Ni/Co/Fe catalysts 3/0.75/0.75 at.%, FeS 1 at.% growth promoter, H2 buffer gas); mean tube diameter 1.85 +/- 0.05 nm (HRTEM; Raman RBM 121 and 138 cm-1 give 1.85 and 1.62 nm); bundles ~20 nm
purification_method: soaked in 37% HCl for 48 h, rinsed with deionized water, dried at 423 K; then vacuum heat treatment at 773 K for 2 h
notes: Residual H2 retained after the system was vented to ambient pressure at room temperature. Abstract: '78.3 percent of the adsorbed hydrogen (3.3 weight percent) could be released under ambient pressure at room temperature, while the release of the residual stored hydrogen (0.9 weight percent) required some heating of the sample.' Table 1: residual 21.7% of total storage capacity; determined by weighing after the samples were brought out (p. 1129; initial mass 492.7 mg, final mass 497.4 mg), so measurement_method other (ex situ weighing on an unnamed balance) and basis_inferred unknown. Pressure printed only as 'ambient pressure' (not a number). Temperature printed as 'room temperature', which the paper gives as 'about 298 K' (p. 1128), stored as 298. No isotherm_id: the 4.2 wt% capacity (M3) comes from the pressure-change apparatus and this value from a separate weighing, so they are not one instrument run. Heating at 473 K removed the weight increase (p. 1129). The Table 1 error statement (<0.38 wt%) is not applied to this abstract value. No surface area or pore volume is reported anywhere in the paper. Degassing: sample cell heated to 423 K (stored as 149.85 C) and vacuum-degassed for 'several hours' (duration not a number, not stored); vacuum printed as 'about 1.3 Pa torr in the control experiment' (unit ambiguous and a control run, not stored). Apparatus described with schematic and component list (Fig. 2: copper sample cell, stainless-steel H2 reservoir, H2 source, vacuum system, high-pressure gauge, bellows valves) but not named; the balance used for this value is not identified, so instrument_identified false. System volume 'measured to be 45.10 ml' with no method stated, so calibration_described false. Paper names no basis (excess/absolute/total) and defines no wt% convention. Material class SWCNT; residual Ni, Co, Fe catalyst recorded as residual metal, not as a composite phase. Reconciliation (agent C): kept from agent B; sample_id S3 is the v0.1 sample 3 (Table 1 sample '3', labelled 'Sample 3'); measurement_id numbered after the v0.1 rows.
